

# rundll32.exe is all Rust (rundll32-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/rundll32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# rundll32.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/rundll32-rust/src/rundll32/rundll32.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(rundll32_res OBJECT rundll32.rc)
target_compile_definitions(rundll32_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(rundll32_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(RUNDLL32_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(rundll32 rundll32-cargo rundll32.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE rundll32-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS rundll32_res ${RUNDLL32_REUSED})
